description.narrative: THE PROGRAM INCLUDES THE IMPLEMENTATION OF INDIVIDUAL SUBPROJECTS FOR THE UPGRADING AND EXPANSION OF WATER AND SANITATION SYSTEMS IN URBAN AND RURAL AREAS. THE SUBPROJECTS WILL SUPPORT THE CONSOLIDATION OF THE SECTOR REFORM PROGRAM. A HIGH PRIORITY WILL BE GIVEN TO SUBPROJECTS FOR THE DECENTRALIZED ENTITIES (PRIMARILY MUNICIPALITIES) THAT HAVE ADVANCED FURTHEST IN THE INTRODUCTION OF THE REFORMS ESPECIALLY THOSE WITH HIGH PROSPECTS FOR PRIVATE SECTOR PARTICIPATION.
